text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This narrative structure allows for a dynamic exploration of the story's themes through contrasting voices. The tone varies significantly depending on the narrator: it is optimistic and curious when voiced by the scientist, and pragmatic and cautious when voiced by the engineer. Additionally, the language style adapts to the subject matter, utilizing technical terminology when discussing machinery and phenomena, while becoming more reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.
